text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, August 6, 2018 Posted by admin on August 6th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL) and Pfizer (PFE). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -8 points.
Friday the Dow was up +136.42 (+0.54%) at 25,462.58.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.01%.
There were 27 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by IBM (IBM) +3.32% and Pfizer (PFE) +2.24%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Boeing (BA) -0.37% and United Technologies (UTX) -0.17%.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down two-tenth of a cent at $2.865 per gallon.
